headlines.title: Bay Area storm live updates: Crews clean up as showers linger
headlines.description: What to Know A strong storm system packing heavy rain and gusty winds that pushed through the Bay Area Wednesday is expected to linger Thursday. Several weather alerts have been issued. View the latest weather alerts here. The storms have sparked outages across the region this week. View an outage map here. Use NBC Bay Area’s interactive radar to track the storm. A powerful storm continues to cause problems across the Bay Area following Wednesday’s record-breaking rainfall, with flooding, power outages and other disruptions impacting the region. Below are the latest storm-related incidents and weather alerts NBC Bay Area is tracking:
headlines.source: Joel Soria, Brendan Weber and Kristofer Noceda
